summary: Full end-to-end testing of AI Client Report Builder (Feature #1). All 9 backend pytest cases passed (branding GET/PUT, generate with notes, generate empty=400, invalid client_id=404, list, get, delete, auth-block). Frontend Playwright flow passed: admin login → /report-builder loads (premium gate passes) → 3 tabs visible (Build/Branding/History) → branding fields editable + saved with 'Branding saved' toast → custom notes generation → report-preview rendered → PDF download triggered (Client_portfolio_review_2026-05-22.pdf) → history shows reports → delete works ('Report deleted' toast). Zero console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py — JSONDecodeError fallback (line 232-237) loses structured content; consider asking GPT to re-emit JSON or use response_format=json_object for openai. Minor: low risk because preview gracefully degrades to executive_summary only.

reports.py line 196: client_info `annual_income` interpolated as raw value into prompt; if a client has annual_income=None it becomes 'RNone' in the LLM context. Minor cosmetic. Recommend formatting numeric fields explicitly.
ReportBuilder.jsx ~500 lines is approaching the 700-line guideline limit but currently OK; consider extracting ReportPreview to its own file if future iterations add more sections.

downloadPdf multi-page logic (lines 459-468) reuses the same imgData across all pages with negative positions — this works for a single tall image but produces a tiled PDF. Acceptable for v1 but if reports get >2 pages, content may render duplicated. Recommend html2canvas-pro or per-page slicing in the future.
